SEARCH
Package utils

Class Messages

java.lang.Object
utils.Messages
public final class Messages extends Object
The Messages class contains various constant string messages used throughout the application. These messages are intended to provide user feedback and prompts during the application's execution, ensuring consistency and ease of modification.
